
```{r}
so_imm <- readRDS(file.path(cache_dir, "sc-processing-sctransform-immune", "so_immune.rds"))
so <- subset(so_imm %>% set_idents("general_cluster_immune"), idents = "Myeloid")
```

# SCTransform

```{r}
so <- run_or_readRDS(
  file.path(file_cache_dir, "so_immune_m.rds"), 
  function() {
    run_seurat_rna_workflow(
      so,
      run_SCT = TRUE,
      resolutions = seq(0.1, 1, 0.1),
      dims = 1:30
    ) 
  }
)
```


```{r}
metadata_df <- get_metadata_from_so(so)
```

## Clustering Analysis

```{r, fig.asp = 1}
#| fig-asp: 1

metadata_df %>%
  dplyr::select(-SCT_snn_res.1) %>%
  pivot_longer(cols = str_subset(colnames(.), "SCT_snn_res")) %>%
  plot_umap(color_str = "value", pointsize = 2.1) +
  geom_text_repel(
    aes(label = value),
    data = ~ ..1 %>%
      group_by(name, value) %>%
      summarise(UMAP_1 = mean(UMAP_1), UMAP_2 = mean(UMAP_2))
  ) +
  facet_wrap( ~ name) +
  theme(legend.position = "none")
```

```{r}
metadata_df %>% 
  plot_umap(color_str = "sample_ID", pointsize = 2.1)
```

# SCTransform, Integrated


```{r}
so_integrated <- run_or_readRDS(
  file.path(file_cache_dir, "so_immune_m_integrated.rds"), 
  function() {
    so_list <-
      subset(so_imm %>% set_idents("cluster_immune"),
             idents = c("1: Myeloid", "9: pDC")) %>%
      SplitObject(split.by = "patient.clin") %>%
      map(SCTransform)
    
    # remove sample with fewer than 100 cells.
    so_list[["1122"]] <- NULL
    
    features <- SelectIntegrationFeatures(object.list = so_list,
                                          nfeatures = 3000)
    so_list <-
      PrepSCTIntegration(object.list = so_list,
                         anchor.features = features)
    immune.anchors <-
      FindIntegrationAnchors(
        object.list = so_list,
        dims = 1:15,
        normalization.method = "SCT",
        anchor.features = features
      )
    so_integrated <- IntegrateData(
      anchorset = immune.anchors,
      normalization.method = "SCT",
      k.weight = 50
    )
    so_integrated <-
      run_seurat_rna_workflow(
        so_integrated,
        set_percentages = FALSE,
        run_normalize = FALSE,
        run_SCT = FALSE,
        dims = 1:30
      )
    so_integrated <- PrepSCTFindMarkers(so_integrated)
    return(so_integrated)
  }
)

```


```{r}
metadata_df <- so_integrated %>% 
  get_metadata_from_so()
```


### Markers res 0.5

```{r}
markers_res0.5 <- run_or_readRDS(
  file.path(file_cache_dir, "dge_one.v.all_res0.5.rds"), 
  function() {
    FindAllMarkers(so_integrated %>% set_assay("SCT") %>% set_idents("integrated_snn_res.0.5"), 
                   assay = "SCT")
  }
)
markers_res0.5_df <- markers_res0.5 %>% 
  as_tibble()
```

```{r}
markers_res0.5_wide <- markers_res0.5_df %>% 
  filter(p_val_adj < 0.05) %>% 
  filter(avg_log2FC > 0) %>% 
  group_by(cluster) %>% 
  arrange(desc(avg_log2FC)) %>% 
  mutate(rank = row_number()) %>% 
  pivot_wider(id_cols = rank, 
              names_from = cluster, 
              values_from = gene) %>% 
  {.[, c("rank", sort(as.character(colnames(.)[-1])))]}
markers_res0.5_wide %>% datatable()
```

Make `general_clusters_M` from resolution 0.5

```{r}
res0.5_key <- c(
  "0: Complement-high macrophages", 
  "1: CXCL8-high monocytes", 
  "2: CXCL10-high macrophages", 
  "3: Stressed", 
  "4: Mito-high", 
  "5: AIF1-high macrophages", 
  "6: Ribo-high", 
  "7: pDC", 
  "8: Proliferating", 
  "9: mDC"
) %>% 
  set_names(0:9)

metadata_to_add <- 
  get_metadata_from_so(so_integrated, metadata = "integrated_snn_res.0.5", reduction = NULL) %>% 
  mutate(clusters_M = res0.5_key[as.character(integrated_snn_res.0.5)]) %>% 
  select(-integrated_snn_res.0.5) %>% 
  column_to_rownames("cell")
so_integrated <- AddMetaData(so_integrated, metadata = metadata_to_add)
```

```{r}
get_metadata_from_so(so_integrated) %>% 
  plot_umap(color_str = "clusters_M", label = T, pointsize = 3.1)
```

### Markers res 0.9

```{r}
markers_res0.9 <- run_or_readRDS(
  file.path(file_cache_dir, "dge_one.v.all_res0.9.rds"), 
  function() {
    FindAllMarkers(so_integrated %>% set_assay("SCT") %>% set_idents("integrated_snn_res.0.9"), 
                   assay = "SCT")
  }
)
markers_res0.9_df <- markers_res0.9 %>% 
  as_tibble()
```

```{r}
markers_res0.9_wide <- markers_res0.9_df %>% 
  filter(p_val_adj < 0.05) %>% 
  filter(avg_log2FC > 0) %>% 
  group_by(cluster) %>% 
  arrange(desc(avg_log2FC)) %>% 
  mutate(rank = row_number()) %>% 
  pivot_wider(id_cols = rank, 
              names_from = cluster, 
              values_from = gene) %>% 
  {.[, c("rank", sort(as.integer(as.character(colnames(.)[-1]))))]}
markers_res0.9_wide %>% datatable()
```

```{r}
res0.9_key <- c(
  "0: CXCL8-high monocytes", 
  "1: APOE-high TAMs", 
  "2: CXCL10-high monocytes", 
  "3: Complement-high TAMs", 
  "4: MHCII-high TAMs", 
  "5: TAMs", 
  "6: CCL4-high TAMs", 
  "7: Stressed", 
  "8: Monocyte", 
  "9: TAMs?", 
  "10: Mito-high", 
  "11: pDC", 
  "12: Mito-high", 
  "13: mDC", 
  "14: SPP1-high TAMs", 
  "15: cDC1", 
  "16: Proliferating TAMs"
) %>% 
  set_names(0:16)

metadata_to_add <- 
  get_metadata_from_so(so_integrated, metadata = "integrated_snn_res.0.9", reduction = NULL) %>% 
  mutate(clusters_M = res0.9_key[as.character(integrated_snn_res.0.9)]) %>% 
  mutate(clusters_M = fct_reorder(clusters_M, as.numeric(as.character(integrated_snn_res.0.9)))) %>% 
  mutate(general_clusters_M = case_when(
    clusters_M %>% str_detect("TAM|onocyte") ~ "TAM", 
    clusters_M %>% str_detect("pDC") ~ "pDC", 
    clusters_M %>% str_detect("DC") ~ "DC", 
    clusters_M %>% str_detect("Proliferating") ~ "Proliferating", 
    clusters_M %>% str_detect("Stressed|Mito") ~ "Stressed", 
    TRUE ~ NA_character_
  )) %>% 
  select(-integrated_snn_res.0.9) %>% 
  column_to_rownames("cell")
so_integrated <- AddMetaData(so_integrated, metadata = metadata_to_add)
```

```{r}
get_metadata_from_so(so_integrated) %>% 
  plot_umap(color_str = "clusters_M", label = T, pointsize = 3.1)
get_metadata_from_so(so_integrated) %>% 
  plot_umap(color_str = "general_clusters_M", label = T, pointsize = 3.1)
```

# Feature UMAPs

```{r}
genes <- c("CD68", "CD14", "CSF1R", "IL1B", "CD40", "CD163")
metadata_df <- get_metadata_from_so(so_integrated) 
gene_expr_df <- get_gene_expr_from_so(so_integrated, assay = "SCT", gene_vec = genes) %>% 
  left_join(metadata_df)
gene_expr_tidy <- gene_expr_df %>% 
  pivot_longer(cols = genes)
```

```{r, fig.asp = 1.5}
plot_umap(gene_expr_tidy, pointsize = 3.1) + 
  facet_wrap(~name, ncol = 2) + 
  scale_color_viridis(limit = c(0, 2.75))
```
